import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()
    
    # Ensure proper sorting within each (user_id, channel) group
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        na_position="last"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Create a session identifier based on the 25-minute gap rule
    # within each (user_id, channel) group independently
    events["session_num"] = 0
    
    # Group by user_id and channel
    for (user_id, channel), group_indices in events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel"], sort=False
    ).groups.items():
        # Process events in order for this (user_id, channel) pair
        group_indices = sorted(group_indices)
        session_num = 1
        events.loc[group_indices[0], "session_num"] = session_num
        
        for i in range(1, len(group_indices)):
            curr_idx = group_indices[i]
            prev_idx = group_indices[i - 1]
            
            curr_ts = events.loc[curr_idx, "event_ts"]
            prev_ts = events.loc[prev_idx, "event_ts"]
            
            # Check if gap exceeds 25 minutes (1500 seconds)
            time_diff = (curr_ts - prev_ts).total_seconds()
            if time_diff > 25 * 60:
                session_num += 1
            
            events.loc[curr_idx, "session_num"] = session_num
    
    # Aggregate to create channel_sessions
    channel_sessions = events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num"],
        sort=False
    ).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "size")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Ensure session_num is 1-based per (user_id, channel) pair
    # Re-rank session numbers within each (user_id, channel) group
    channel_sessions["session_num_rank"] = channel_sessions.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel"],
        sort=False
    )["session_start"].rank(method="first").astype("int64")
    
    channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions["session_num_rank"]
    channel_sessions = channel_sessions.drop(columns=["session_num_rank"])
    
    # Sort for output consistency
    channel_sessions = channel_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_num"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Ensure correct column order and types
    channel_sessions = channel_sessions[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]
    
    channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions["session_num"].astype("int64")
    channel_sessions["event_count"] = channel_sessions["event_count"].astype("int64")
    
    return {"channel_sessions": channel_sessions}
